claim_ceiling: Sampled development entropy-ceiling probe only. Estimated bytes are not a decodable artifact, codec result, baseline win, validation result, or state-of-the-art claim. Public validation and private holdout remain sealed and unaccessed.

dictionary_policy.ranking: descending estimated raw-byte savings, then descending occurrence count, then bytewise token order
dictionary_policy.serialization: AXPD1 magic, track byte, 256 canonical unsigned-varint raw-byte prior weights, canonical unsigned-varint entry count, then ranking-order canonical unsigned-varint token length, token bytes, and token prior weight

estimator.adaptive_reset: reset all counts at each sampled chunk boundary
estimator.alphabet: 256 raw-byte symbols followed by ranking-order dictionary-token symbols
estimator.trained_prior_weight: one plus integer square root of the training-sample occurrence count; absent raw bytes receive weight one

name: text-source-predictor-entropy-ceiling-probe-v1

sampling.offset_policy: For N bytes and C chunks of S bytes, use offset floor(i * (N - S) / (C - 1)) for i in [0,C); use the complete item once when N <= S.
sampling.upper_bound: mean sampled bits-per-byte plus two population-standard-error units; single-chunk items use their observed bits-per-byte

english_wikimedia_wikitext.learned_token_pattern: ASCII words beginning with a letter and continuing with letters, digits, apostrophe, underscore, or hyphen
english_wikimedia_wikitext.matching: fixed markup tokens take longest-match precedence; learned tokens match complete scanner words only; every unmatched byte is emitted raw

source_code_bundles.learned_token_pattern: ASCII identifiers beginning with a letter or underscore and continuing with letters, digits, or underscore
source_code_bundles.matching: learned tokens match complete scanner identifiers only; every unmatched byte is emitted raw
